dogecoin.text: Some of the Elon skits on #SNL were pretty funny. Unfortunately, that's not going to stand the test of time. There were far too many jokes that won't make any sense down the road unless you remember 2020-21 pretty well, including many Twitter, $Doge, Tesla & SpaceX references.
Ok, Elon is worth it. And his mom got the first #Dogecoin joke in!
He's just pissed that he missed out on #Dogecoin at under a penny. 🤣
